title: thermify: Efficient Agroclimatic Thermal Indices

creators.name: Fuentes-Jaque, Guillermo
creators.affiliation: Universidad San Sebastián; Instituto de Ciencias y Tecnología Ambiental ICTA Ltda., Chile

description:
thermify is an R package for efficient, reproducible and spatially explicit agroclimatic thermal indices: growing degree-days (average, single and double sine, single and double triangle, with horizontal, vertical and intermediate cutoffs), degree-hours, chilling hours, Utah model chill units and Dynamic model chill portions, from hourly, daily or monthly temperatures.

Monthly climatologies such as WorldClim 2.1 are densified to daily values with a mean-preserving method (natively or through tempify) and disaggregated to hours; rasters are processed in blocks with terra. Results based on monthly climatologies are model-based estimates, not observations.

Documentation: https://djwillichile.github.io/thermify/
